name: Studio mini

providers.authDetail: Deterministic scripted provider; no model or account is used.
limitations: Follows scripted demo and test workflows only; it cannot handle open-ended requests.

profiles.name: native
profiles.summary: Trusted native execution in a per-job git worktree under the runner's account, using each provider's own sandbox and permission controls. A worktree is not a sandbox.

profiles.name: readonly
profiles.summary: Detached, read-only snapshot of the exact revision, with the provider in its read-only permission mode.

profiles.name: container
profiles.reason: Docker is not installed here. Run a runner inside the yip container image (packaging/container) to offer this profile; this runner runs natively.

serviceState: foreground process (not supervised: stops if this session ends)
